source_text: Two branch valves cannot be represented until expert review confirms whether both valves lie on one branch or one valve lies on each of two branches.

reasons: The required branch ownership and topology are ambiguous.

observed_issue: The existing layout format cannot assign two valve instances to unambiguous branch-local pipe chains.
requested_action: Require expert-accepted topology, stable valve IDs, parent-branch ownership, local station, orientation, piping associations, envelopes and collision checks before plotting.
